name: Release smoke test
responsibility: Installs the packed packages from a local registry, as a user does, and runs the installed archboard on a PATH with no Bun, Node.js or Rust
description: A local registry serves the tarballs of the release build and passes every other request, such as the Codex platform package, to registry.npmjs.org. npm or Bun installs archboard or @archboard/cli from it. The installed archboard must report the packed version, start a server, report a release server of that version, and stop it, with a scratch state directory and a free loopback port. The script imports nothing from the checkout.
